title: Attachments · Phase 2.4
description: Native photo and file picking, previews, restored attachments and supported vision-model sending.
notes: Attach up to four photos, UTF-8 text files, or PDFs with selectable text. Images resize before sending; documents use extracted text. Unsupported files and models show an error before the draft is accepted.
Preview and remove attachments before sending. Draft references and originals are saved in protected account-scoped files. Temporary attachment bytes stay in memory.
Vision requests use native image formats for supported OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic and Groq models. Small originals reuse the web file schema; unknown existing message fields remain preserved.
